Platform invoices
Guided monthly run: Hosthub expect → automated portal pull → review → email accountants. Booking.com = one invoice per apartment. Connect portals once; no monthly PDF upload. Do this as soon as possible.
1 · Start the month run
Pick the document month (when invoices/credit notes were issued). Booking.com: invoice the month after the bookings. Airbnb VAT invoices follow Hosthub created; credit notes follow cancelledAt.
2 · What we expect (Hosthub)
Airbnb uses Hosthub confirmation codes (reservationId) — same workflow as VAT Invoicer. VAT invoice = created month; credit note = cancelledAt month. Booking.com is parked for now.
3 · Collect documents
Test pull (5 codes) uses the latest 5 Hosthub codes: stay/reservation page → click total price → VAT invoice HTML → PDF (Airbnb Help + VAT Invoicer privacy flow). Then Pull Airbnb (Hosthub codes) for the full month. Connect Airbnb once if OTP blocks login.
PDFs by apartment — click Open to view
Emergency manual tools (not the normal path)
Other groups (optional)
Separate packs for partner accountants — same month.
4 · Review before shipping
PDFs by apartment — click Open to view
5 · Ship finished product
Emails the Elysian-tax PDF pack to the accountants (default: E-New Generation + info@elysianproperties.eu).

Hosthub API connection
How this works
1. Paste your Hosthub API key (Settings → API Keys → Create new API key)
2. Click Test connection — this discovers which endpoints respond on your account
3. Set the date range and click Fetch bookings
4. Click Load into app to replace the current booking data

Note: This requires running npm start (not just opening the HTML file) so the built-in proxy can forward requests to Hosthub without CORS issues.
